content:
昨日發布一輪保安修補程式後，Apple 今日公佈 Safari 26.6.1 的保安內容詳情。詳情如下。

Codex 在 CVE 致謝名單中多次出現。

Apple 今日更新其「Apple 保安發布」網頁，列出 Safari 26.6.1 的漏洞修補詳情，此版本現適用於 macOS Sonoma 及 macOS Sequoia。

根據相關文件，是次更新包含 22 個 CVE，全部與 WebKit 相關，其中兩個漏洞涉及處理「惡意製作的網絡內容」，可能導致記憶體損壞。

值得留意的是，與近期保安更新一樣，OpenAI Codex Security 出現了九次，進一步凸顯 AI 工具在協助發現 Apple 軟件保安漏洞方面日益重要。

以下是 Apple 為 Safari 26.6.1 發布的完整保安內容：

Safari 26.6.1 Released: August 18, 2026 WebKit Available for: macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash Description: An out-of-bounds access issue was addressed by improving border checks. WebKit Bugzilla: 317632 CVE-2026-64784: Janggoon Lee (Out of Bounds), OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improving memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 313452 CVE-2026-43795: wwwlk WebKit Bugzilla: 318348 CVE-2026-65338: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption WebKit Bugzilla: 318405 CVE-2026-65341: Henock Habte WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improving locking mechanisms. WebKit Bugzilla: 321480 CVE-2026-64782: Seonwook Kim, Shubham Chaskar, lattice, Josef Korbel WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improving input validation. WebKit Bugzilla: 321484 CVE-2026-64781: Thomas Guillem WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improving state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 321517 CVE-2026-65351: Niels Hofmans WebKit Bugzilla: 316996 CVE-2026-65340: Claudio Bozzato and Francesco Benvenuto (Cisco Talos), Josef Korbel (Citadelo) WebKit Bugzilla: 317142 CVE-2026-65337: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317349 CVE-2026-65336: Josef Korbel WebKit Bugzilla: 316723 CVE-2026-65335: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317603 CVE-2026-65333: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317450 CVE-2026-65332: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317611 CVE-2026-65331: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash Description: A use-after-free issue was addressed by improving memory management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316347 CVE-2026-64715: Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) (TrendAI Zero Day Initiative) WebKit Description: The issue was addressed by improving check mechanisms. WebKit Bugzilla: 316918 CVE-2026-64780: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improving state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316791 CVE-2026-65334: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed by improving memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 317317 CVE-2026-43794: Dung Do (@_piers2) (Calif.io) WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination WebKit Bugzilla: 313703 CVE-2026-64787: Sota Sugiyama, Shubham Chaskar WebKit History Impact: Visiting a maliciously crafted website may lead to sensitive data leakage WebKit Bugzilla: 315528 CVE-2026-64778: Mohit Negi WebKit Storage WebKit Bugzilla: 321485 CVE-2026-64779: Shubham Chaskar, Tommy DeVoss (Braze Security Team, @thedawgyg) Additional Acknowledgements WebKit We would like to thank Henock Habte for their assistance.
